fusions.name: Rote Verse
fusions.desc: Sings a drilled phrase that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 35% chance to leave it ringing with [Vibrant Echo] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Coda
fusions.desc: A closing note that deals 18 damage to an enemy up to 8 tiles away and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Taught by Ear
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Refrain
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again and the second roll stands. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
